scope: Read-only multilingual and visual production QA; accessibility and typography excluded by user instruction.
productionFindings: Non-Hebrew home pages expose Hebrew catalog, review and editorial content.
Raw ISO review dates remain visible in non-Hebrew locales.
French still exposes rejected literal labels such as Séjours à l'heure, quand sors-tu and qui vient.
Representative localized navigation preserved the active locale in completed desktop and mobile checks.
The supplied gift-card overlap did not reproduce on the current public build at 1365x768, but the geometric collision detector is now part of every recurring run.
Search and spa routes can exceed the configured 20-second case budget, which is retained as a production performance/reliability finding rather than hidden.
